question: A water tank can be filled by two inlets, labeled A and B, in 12 hours and 15 hours respectively. An outlet pipe C can empty the tank in 10 hours. If all three pipes are opened together, how much time will it take to fill the tank?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM of 12, 15, 10 = 60 units

A fills = 60 ÷ 12 = 5 units/hr

B fills = 60 ÷ 15 = 4 units/hr

C empties = 60 ÷ 10 = 6 units/hr

Net = 5 + 4 − 6 = 3 units/hr

Time = 60 ÷ 3 = 20 hours

**∴ Answer = 20 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A fills in 12 hr, B fills in 15 hr, C empties in 10 hr

**Table Method (LCM = 60 units):**

 
 

 Pipe
 Work (units/hr)
 
 

 A
 5
 
 

 B
 4
 
 

 C
 −6
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Net work per hour = 5 + 4 − 6 = 3 units/hr

⇒ Total work = 60 units

⇒ Time = 60 ÷ 3 = 20 hours

**∴ Final Answer: 20 hours**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**LCM Method:** Assume total work = LCM of given times.

**Inlet vs Outlet:** Inlet adds work, outlet subtracts work.

**Efficiency:** Work per hour = Total work ÷ Time

**Exam Tip:** Always convert to same unit (LCM) for speed.
